skill.name: executor-brainstorm
skill.description: Guide feature design through repository research, independent concepts, adversarial critique, and a human decision. Record the chosen design for specification and planning.
skill.summary: Turn rough feature ideas or open design questions into recorded, human-approved decisions.
skill.author: atri10

security_audit.summary: Of 132 static findings, 129 are formatting, fixed sibling references, or legitimate local checks; three retain uncertainty about required, unreviewed helper execution. One semantic finding identifies missing confidentiality review for public design records. No evidence found of malicious prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or network reconnaissance in the four supplied files.

remediation.issue: Required helper scripts are outside the reviewed package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle or pin and audit the required helpers. Resolve them from a trusted installation directory and require approval before running unverified dependencies.

remediation.issue: Public session records can contain confidential information beyond secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Classify and redact personal, customer, and proprietary information before writing public records. Require explicit publication approval and provide private storage.

content.user_title: Compare Feature Designs Before Specification and Planning
content.value_statement: Rough feature ideas can become specifications before alternatives and failure cases are examined. This skill structures research, independent concepts, critique, and human decisions into a recorded design.
actual_capabilities: Structure a brief with actors, measurable outcomes, constraints, non-goals, and weighted evaluation criteria.
Guide a prior-art scout to cite repository evidence, integration touchpoints, conventions, and unresolved gaps.
Dispatch three or four independent concept explorers using distinct design lenses.
Apply ten critique methods to leading concepts, including scale, rollback, security, and accessibility.
Compare concepts against weighted criteria and a status-quo baseline before recording the human choice.
Record design dossiers and focused decisions with handoff material for specification, planning, and architecture.
limitations: Full workflow verification depends on sibling Executor scripts and references not included in these four files.
Parallel exploration requires a harness with subagent support; stage approvals require available human input.
External design research is only verified when web search is available.
Public session records need confidentiality review beyond the prescribed secrets scan.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a New Product Capability
use_cases.description: Compare distinct feature concepts against agreed user outcomes, costs, and constraints before selecting a design.

use_cases.title: Resolve an Architecture Question
use_cases.description: Generate at least three options for storage or synchronization, examine precedent and failure cases, and record the chosen approach.

use_cases.title: Prepare Planning Boundaries
use_cases.description: Use decision mode to compare specification decomposition options and record the selected plan boundaries before planning begins.

prompt_templates.title: Frame a Rough Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Use executor-brainstorm for this idea: [idea]. Start with a design brief and ask me to approve actors, outcomes, constraints, and evaluation weights.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: establish a clear problem before exploring solutions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Feature Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Design [feature] in [repository]. Research [focus areas], compare three independent lenses and the status quo, critique leading concepts, and ask for my decision.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: explore alternatives with repository evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve One Design Question
prompt_templates.prompt: Run decision mode for [question]. Generate at least three options, identify known approaches, challenge the favorite, and record my choice for [phase].
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: resolve one architecture or decomposition decision.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Constrained Design Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Run design mode for [capability] under [constraints]. Compare robustness, experience, and reuse lenses; test failure flows, rollback, and tenfold scale. Document requirement candidates and increments. Obtain my approval before deciding, and review confidentiality before writing public records. Report unavailable helpers instead of claiming verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a traceable dossier with explicit operational and publication boundaries.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: compare self-service tenant onboarding approaches with low operational cost.
output: Brief: let tenant administrators onboard without operator assistance; agree success measures and constraints before concept exploration.
Concepts: manual approval with automation, guided self-service, and asynchronous provisioning, plus the current process as a baseline.
Stress test: examine duplicate submissions, failed provisioning, authorization mistakes, and recovery paths.
Decision: the human chooses guided self-service and records the operational tradeoff.
Handoff: requirement candidates for each flow, an initial delivery slice, and unresolved assumptions.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: choose how a specification should split into implementation plans.
output: Options: split by user journey, by domain boundary, or by delivery increment.
Known approaches: compare each split with existing repository conventions and explain what it borrows.
Adversarial pass: examine integration dependencies, migration order, and rollback costs for the favored split.
Outcome: record the human choice, rationale, and planning phase that receives the decision.

best_practices: Agree measurable outcomes, constraints, and evaluation weights before generating concepts.
Keep explorers independent and record every critique finding with an explicit disposition.
Review public records for confidential information and verify trusted companion helpers before claiming completion.
anti_patterns: Choose the winning concept first and adjust evaluation weights afterward.
Let explorers read sibling concepts or let a concept author critique their own work.
Mark a session decided without the human choice or claim verification when required helpers are unavailable.

faq.question: When should I use design mode?
faq.answer: Use design mode for a new feature or capability that needs a complete design before specification.

faq.question: When should I use decision mode?
faq.answer: Use decision mode for one open design question or planning decomposition. It compares at least three options and normally runs without subagents.

faq.question: Who chooses the final design?
faq.answer: The human chooses after reviewing the concepts and critique. If no choice is made, the session remains draft.

faq.question: What does the skill produce?
faq.answer: Design mode records a dossier, concepts, prior art, critique, risks, and handoff material. Decision mode records options, an adversarial pass, and an outcome.

faq.question: Are these four files enough for the complete workflow?
faq.answer: No. The complete workflow references sibling Executor helpers and documentation. Parallel design exploration also requires subagent support in the host harness.

faq.question: Can I include confidential project information?
faq.answer: The instructions describe the store as public. Use private storage or approved, redacted inputs; a secrets scan does not establish publication permission.
